readMe: Approval levels for the approve window. Outside a window nothing here approves anything: you answer every prompt yourself. Inside a window you open, routine items are approved at once (the app knows the everyday options of the commands in its own lists; any other command you add counts only exactly as you wrote it); yours items are never approved for you. A yours word is matched anywhere in the call, whatever its case, quotes or spacing. Besides these lists, a command that deletes (rm of a folder, a wildcard or more than one file, del, rd, Remove-Item, find -delete and code that does the same), force pushes, deletes a branch, hard resets, deploys, publishes, merges a pull request, or empties a database table is always yours, in any flag order, behind git's global options, shortened, quoted or wrapped (lib/never-approve.js); a script file that does the same is not read. Everything else is left for you, or, only when you set "judge": true in hq.config.json, goes to a quick AI check on your own Claude login. Edit this file by hand. Never let a model edit the yours lists.
